_comment: Texture an EXISTING mesh with Hunyuan3D 2.1 TexGen. Separate from the shape pass on purpose: loading ShapeGen and TexGen in one graph exceeds 16GB VRAM, and splitting also means a failed texture never costs you the geometry, and that any generator's mesh can be textured. mesh_path is a CONTAINER path. The reference image should be the same concept the shape came from. create_pbr writes albedo + metallic + roughness.
